name: Warpriest Vassal
body:
Vassals are dedicated to the highest ideals their alignment represents. Any devotion to a deity or other higher power is secondary to a vassal’s commitment to upholding and promoting good, evil, chaos, or law.

A vassal has the following class features.

Special

A vassal’s alignment must be CN, LN, NG, or NE. If a vassal worships a deity, the deity’s alignment must exactly match the vassal’s alignment.

Class Skills

A vassal gains Knowledge (planes) as a class skill.

This alters class skills.

Aura

A vassal’s aura corresponds to the non-neutral component of their chosen alignment. For example, a NG vassal’s aura is good. This alters aura.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Vassals do not gain proficiency with the favored weapon of their deity or with heavy armor. Vassals gain damage reduction based upon the alignment of their aura. Good aligned vassals gain DR/evil. Evil aligned vassals gain DR/good. Chaotic aligned vassals gain DR/law. Lawful aligned vassals gain DR/chaotic. At 1st level, the amount of this damage reduction is 1. This damage reduction increases by +1 for every five vassal levels, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies and replaces sacred armor.

Aligned Convictions

At 1st level, vassals gain only one blessing which must be the alignment blessing matching their aura. Furthermore, vassals gain the ability to detect the alignment that directly opposes the alignment of their own aura. (Good opposes evil, chaos opposes law, and vice versa.) As a swift action, vassals can use detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, or detect law (as previously specified) as a spell-like ability, usable at will.

This alters blessings.

Alignment Focus (Ex)

At 1st level, vassals gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls when attacking a creature if at least one component of the creature’s alignment does not match the vassal’s aura alignment.

This replaces focus weapon.

Conviction Pool (Su)

At 1st level, vassals gain a reserve of magical energy in the form of a conviction pool, which they can use to accomplish amazing feats, promoting the ideals of their alignment. A vassal can spend 1 point from this pool to activate any of the abilities listed below. A vassal’s conviction pool contains 1 point at 1st level. At 4th level, and every four levels thereafter, 1 more point is added to the conviction pool, to a maximum of 6 points at 20th level.

This replaces sacred weapon.

Aligned Magic

As a standard action, a specified spell, unique to each vassal’s aura alignment, can be used as a spell-like ability, using the vassal’s level as the caster level. Each spell-like ability requires the vassal to attain a minimum level to be used. The 10th level spell cannot be used more than once per day, regardless of how many points are available in the vassal’s conviction pool.

Chaotic Aura—protection from law (1st), shard of chaos (4th), chaos hammer (10th) Evil Aura—protection from good (1st), dread bolt (4th), unholy blight (10th) Good Aura—protection from evil (1st), spear of purity (4th), holy smite (10th) Lawful Aura—protection from chaos (1st), arrow of law (4th), order’s wrath (10th)

Buffered Resolve

As an immediate action, this ability can be activated to gain a +2 morale bonus against mindaffecting effects for a number of rounds equal to the vassal’s Wisdom modifier. This bonus increases by +2 at 4th and 10th level.

Empowered Aura

As a swift action, vassals can project their aura in a radius of themselves equal to 5 feet + 5 ft./4 levels, to a maximum of 30 feet at 20th level. All enemies within this aura suffer a -2 penalty to attack rolls and armor class. Enemies with an alignment component corresponding to the vassal’s aura alignment are not adversely affected by this ability. Once activated, this ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to the vassal’s Wisdom modifier.
